description: This file defines a class 'PendingAppraisalReviewSummary' within HR management software. The class implements the 'ActionSummary' interface and provides functionality to summarize pending appraisal reviews for an employee, including initializing review filter parameters and methods to retrieve group info and pending review counts.

classes.name: PendingAppraisalReviewSummary
classes.description: A class that summarizes pending appraisal reviews for a specific employee, utilizing filtering parameters and external services for data retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the summary with an employee number and sets review statuses to filter for pending reviews.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the identifier for the group category, fixed as 3.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the name of the group category: 'Pending Appraisal Reviews'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of pending appraisal reviews for the employee based on current filter parameters.
